functions.name: _core_i2c_timing
functions.brief: Resolve the TIMINGR value for a given speed using the compile-time I2C kernel clock (I2C_KERNEL_CLK_MHZ from core_config.h). Returns 0 if no pre-computed value exists.

functions.name: core_i2c_init
functions.signature: core_i2c_init(core_i2c_t * h, I2C_TypeDef * instance, uint32_t speed_hz)
functions.brief: Initialize an I2C bus with automatic timing resolution. core_i2c_t bus; core_i2c_init(&bus, I2C1, I2C_400K); Resolves the TIMINGR value from the compile-time kernel clock. Enables FMP mode automatically when speed is I2C_1M.

functions.name: core_i2c_init_cfg
functions.signature: core_i2c_init_cfg(core_i2c_t * h, I2C_TypeDef * instance, const hal_i2c_config_t * cfg)
functions.brief: Initialize I2C with explicit config struct (advanced). For most use cases, prefer core_i2c_init(h, instance, speed_hz).

functions.brief: Check if a device responds at addr. Returns I2C_OK or I2C_NACK.

functions.name: core_i2c_scan
functions.signature: core_i2c_scan(core_i2c_t * h, uint8_t * found, uint8_t * count, uint8_t max_count)
functions.brief: Scan the I2C bus (0x08–0x77). Fills found[] with responding addresses.

functions.name: core_i2c_write_byte_bus
functions.signature: core_i2c_write_byte_bus(uint8_t bus, uint8_t addr, uint16_t reg, uint8_t value)
functions.brief: Write a single byte to a register on a device on `bus`. Returns I2C_OK on success, I2C_NACK / I2C_ERROR on bus failure, or I2C_ERROR if `bus` isn't declared in config.json.

functions.name: core_i2c_read_byte_bus
functions.signature: core_i2c_read_byte_bus(uint8_t bus, uint8_t addr, uint16_t reg)
functions.brief: Read a single byte from a register on a device on `bus`. Returns the byte value (0..255) on success, or -1 on any error (bus undeclared, NACK, timeout). The signed return lets DSL programs branch on `< 0` without an out-pointer.

functions.name: core_i2c_probe_bus
functions.brief: Check if a device responds at `addr` on `bus`. Returns 1 if the device ACKs, 0 on NACK / timeout / undeclared bus.
